d: We are looking for an experienced and technically proficient Assistant Manager – External Audit to support the planning, execution, and delivery of external audit engagements.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in external auditing, with proven experience supervising audit teams, managing multiple engagements, maintaining client relationships, and ensuring audit quality and compliance with professional standards.
q: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field .
Minimum 6.5 years of relevant audit experience , preferably within an external audit or professional services environment.
Professional qualification such as ACCA, CPA, or CA is mandatory.
Strong technical knowledge of external auditing, financial reporting, audit procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Proven experience managing audit engagements, reviewing working papers, and supervising audit teams.
Experience in audit planning, risk assessment, engagement budgeting, and resource management.
Strong client relationship management, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and decision-making abilities.
Ability to manage multiple engagements and deliver high-quality work within deadlines.
Proficiency in spoken and written Arabic and English is required.
Familiarity with CaseWare and audit documentation systems would be an advantage.

d: Hays are working with a boutique family-focused Company Service Provider, part of a wider global group, as they setting up a new office in DIFC and looking to appoint a Compliance Officer & MLRO Officer. This is a rare opportunity to build the compliance function from the ground up, working alongside a leading law firm to shape the framework.

The selected professional be responsible for will implementing and maintaining the compliance framework and AML/CFT/CPF and sanctions program, acting as designated MLRO and principal point of contact for all matters. They will oversee client onboarding, KYC/CDD/EDD and risk assessments, and support the DFSA application and ongoing regulatory engagement. The role reports to the Senior Executive Officer, with independent access to the Board on MLRO matters.
q: Minimum 5 years’ compliance, AML or regulatory experience in the UAE with DIFC/DFSA exposure (ADGM experience also considered)
Strong knowledge of the DFSA AML Rulebook and UAE Federal AML/CFT requirements
Background in a corporate service provider or regulated financial services environment (in-house or consultancy)
CAMS, ICA, CISI or equivalent preferred
Hands-on, proactive and confident, with sound judgement and the ability to make decisions in a lean, growing team
The client is offering a competitive package and a unique opportunity to join a newly established entity in the DIFC under the group.
To apply or for a confidential discussion, please follow the link and apply directly.

d: Hiring: Head of Power Systems Studies – Oman
We are seeking an experienced Head of Power Systems Studies to lead our Grid Impact Assessment and Power Systems Engineering division, supporting OETC and Nama Distribution projects across Oman.
Lead and manage power system studies and engineering projects.
Oversee grid impact, load flow, short-circuit, harmonic, and dynamic stability studies.
Manage engineering teams, project schedules, and technical deliverables.
Review and approve technical reports for submission to OETC and DCRP.
Coordinate with utilities, clients, and project stakeholders.
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience for Omani nationals or 15 years for expatriates.
Strong technical knowledge of DIgSILENT PowerFactory, ETAP, or PSS®E.
Proven experience in grid impact assessments and power system studies.
Previous managerial or technical leadership experience.
OETC, Nama, or GCC utility experience preferred.
Candidates currently outside Oman are welcome to apply.
Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV and relevant project experience.
